title: Distillery District Breakfast Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Cannot accommodate a Vegan, Gluten-Free, Nut-Free, or Dairy-Free Diet
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Indulge in a unique morning experience in the Distillery District with our Breakfast Tour.

Enjoy a hot coffee or tea, savory treats, and a delicious breakfast sandwich. Sip and munch as you stroll through Toronto's peaceful Distillery District neighbourhood. Discover classic Victorian era architecture & fascinating history before the neighbourhood gets busy.

Book now for a captivating and tasty start to your day!
